target.statement: PIWR estimate of transmission rate α for COVID-19 SIDR model with 1% noise, achieving 0.124% error (Table 2, row α, column PIWR, noise level ε=0.01)
target.dataset: Synthetic COVID-19 SIDR data generated from the model with parameters (α,β,γ)=(0.191,0.05,0.0294), 100 samples on [0,500] days, 1% noise

compute.basis: The method is closed-form least squares on a small linear system (400x7); data generation and fitting take milliseconds, and the paper reports <1 ms per fit.

blockers: No code released for PIWR or the conformal pipeline; must implement from paper description
Data must be regenerated from model equations (no provided dataset)
title: Conformalized Physics-Informed Weak Regression for Parameter Estimation in Epidemic Models
